name: SocialDataX Sensitive Text Check
description: Screen text for potential platform review risks and query SocialDataX points balance; screening does not guarantee platform acceptance.

inputs.label: SocialDataX API Key
inputs.description: Your SocialDataX API Key, sent only to the hosted SocialDataX service. Business tool calls consume SocialDataX credits.

obtain.instructions:
1. Open the SocialDataX website and sign in.
2. Obtain your own SocialDataX API Key.
3. Add credits before making business tool calls.
4. Paste the API Key into this secret field.

auth.instructions: Use your own SocialDataX API Key as a Bearer token; business tool calls consume SocialDataX credits.
